description_en: Cancels scheduled tasks that have not started
description_zh: 取消开始时间尚未到达的定时任务
kebab_example: aliyun polardb cancel-schedule-tasks --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --task-id ec8c4723-eac5-4f12-becb-01ac08000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelScheduleTasks

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to view information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scheduled task to cancel.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199648.html operation to view information about all scheduled tasks for your account, including task IDs.

You can cancel only tasks that are in the pending state. The `Status` parameter for these tasks returns `pending`
parameters.help_zh:
需要被取消的定时任务的任务ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199648.html接口查看当前账号下所有计划任务的信息，包括任务ID。
仅任务状态为等待执行（即`Status`参数的返回值为`pending`）的任务支持被取消
parameters.name: task_id

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
